title.narrative: Oloolua Forest Eco Tourism Forest conservation project

description.narrative: Partner: Oloolua Forest Ecotourism Community Based Organization (OFECBO)Project Title:' Enhancing the protection, conservation and rehabilitation of Oloolua Forest' Project Objective: To enhance and coordinate protection, conservation and rehabilitation of Oloolua ForestExpected Outcomes: - Adequate facilities for protection, conservation and rehabilitation of Oloolua Forest - Enhanced opportunity for women and other community members to generate revenues to meet their humanitarian needs - Effective climate change action through environmental conservation (carbon sink)Project Activities: Construction of a site to promote the protection, conservation and rehabilitation of the forest. Key activities include installation of a 40ft Container, refurbished, to serve as the interim operations centre; construction of an ablution unit; clearing of the parking lot; procurement and fixture of a water tank ND plumbing. Additional support for the rest of the activities under the project will be supported by through community contributions, Kenya Forest Services and Kajiado County.
